text: 杭可科技公告，拟以集中竞价交易方式回购公司股份，回购资金总额不低于人民币5000万元（含）、不超过人民币1亿元（含），回购价格不超过人民币28元/股（含），回购期限为董事会审议通过回购方案之日起3个月内。回购股份全部用于维护公司价值及股东权益，披露回购结果暨股份变动公告12个月后拟通过集中竞价交易方式出售，并于该公告披露后3年内完成出售；未能按期完成出售的，未出售部分将履行相关程序予以注销。资金来源为自有资金或自筹资金（含回购专项贷款资金），公司已取得工商银行杭州分行不超过人民币9000万元的专项贷款承诺，具体贷款事宜以双方签订的融资协议为准。
text_en: Hangke Technology announced that it plans to repurchase company shares through centralized bidding, with total repurchase funds of no less than RMB 50 million (inclusive) and no more than RMB 100 million (inclusive), a repurchase price of no more than RMB 28 per share (inclusive), and a repurchase period of within 3 months from the date the board of directors approves the repurchase plan. The repurchased shares will all be used to safeguard the company's value and shareholders' rights and interests, and are planned to be sold through centralized bidding 12 months after disclosure of the repurchase result and share change announcement, with the sale to be completed within 3 years after such announcement; if the sale is not completed on schedule, the unsold portion will be cancelled through relevant procedures. The source of funds is own funds or self-raised funds (including special loan funds for repurchase). The company has obtained a special loan commitment of no more than RMB 90 million from ICBC Hangzhou Branch, with specific loan matters subject to the financing agreement signed by both parties.
